input.description: User-supplied actual photograph of Milky smiling with tongue visible, seated on pink/floral bedding.
input.publication: Original input photo and comparison images are not bundled or committed.

attempts.reason: Initial extraction enhanced fur and rounded paw contours; rejected after source comparison.
Stronger background-only prompt retains the original softer photo quality, expression and pink/grey lighting more faithfully.

conversion.method: @napi-rs/canvas high-quality proportional downscale, WebP quality92; final runtime427x600.
conversion.creativeEdits: All background-removal editing used built-in ImageGen only. No Python image editing, manual alpha masking, alternate network API, tape, lettering or border applied.

validation.rootVisualApproval: Root reviewed the second extraction against the source photograph and approved this output for the small contour-cut scrapbook photograph.
validation.identityCaveat: Background removed via ImageGen; small reconstructed edge areas are possible. The result is not pixel-identical to the original photograph.
validation.alpha: Actual decoded runtime has true alpha; all four corners transparent. Dog body reaches254/255 alpha with short antialiasing and no visible background matte.
validation.privacy: Source photograph and source-comparison QA remain outside repository; only the selected generated cutout is committed.
validation.uiContract: Use427x600 intrinsic dimensions and natural aspect ratio. Create only on the final letter, below the letter prose with flower/heart stickers; no tape.
